title: A counterexample to the Monge ansatz for the three-marginal Coulomb cost
main_claim: There is a smooth compactly supported density rho on R^3, with sqrt(rho) also smooth, for which the three-marginal Coulomb Kantorovich minimum is finite and attained, but no measure-preserving Borel maps T2,T3 attain it. The Monge infimum still equals the Kantorovich minimum. The same holds for every Riesz cost |x|^{-s}, s>0, in every dimension d>=2.
coverage:
I read the full LaTeX source: introduction, the splitting lemma, the local branches lemma, the certificate proposition, the common-ball lemma, the proof of the main theorem, the equality-of-infima section with its Borel transport lemma, and the Riesz extension. Checks I made by hand:
- Center jets: c(0,a,-a)=5/2, grad_x=0, grad_z=(5/4)a. The Riesz analogues are 2+2^{-s} and s(1+2^{-s-1})a.
- Hessian of |b|^{-1}: eigenvalues 2|b|^{-3} and -|b|^{-3} (twice). The Riesz radial and tangential eigenvalues are s(s+1)|b|^{-s-2} and -s|b|^{-s-2}.
- The two blocks of N_k are -D^2h(-a_k) and -D^2h(-2a_k), and the limit argument as K grows that keeps both blocks of (M+KI)^{-1}N_k invertible holds.
- Strict convexity on a product of balls gives a unique minimum, so the equality set is exactly as stated.
- Strict cost gaps for the other center patterns: 2+1/sqrt2 > 5/2, and 2+2^{-s/2} > 2+2^{-s}. For two points in the same ball the bound 1/(2r) > 3M holds.
- Shrinking U_k^+ at the end keeps X_k(U_k^+) and Z_k(U_k^+) inside the right balls.
- Splitting lemma: the 1/3 versus 1/6 mass comparison on S_j and H_j(S_j) is correct.
- Every coordinate marginal of pi_0 is exactly mu, and the zero-slack argument forces optimal plans onto the contact set.
- On the central component, a map must select one of the four branches.
- Infima section: the slab splitting into pieces B_ijk, the pushforward computation, the requirement that each cell product gets exactly mass q_ijk, and the oscillation bounds 6delta/eta^2 and 6s delta eta^{-s-1}.
- The Rosenblatt and quantile Borel transport construction.
All of these hold.
sibling_notes: No other branch had posted to the family 373 board yet. The construction adapts the splitting mechanism of Gerolin, Kausamo and Rajala; its arguments are self-contained and depend on no companion OAI paper.
